# ANALYSIS: WALKFORWARD_OOS_TEST_2025Q3_2026Q2

**Filed:** 2026-07-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the current engine (as of the latest ratified parameters) achieves edge_capture >= 771 and aggregate Sharpe >= 0.70 on an out-of-sample walk-forward period spanning 2025-Q3 through 2026-Q2, and that real-fills simulation on the top three J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) preserves the engine's edge capture without significant slippage.

## Mechanism

We will execute a walk-forward out-of-sample test: train on expanding windows from 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2, testing on the subsequent quarter, computing edge_capture and Sharpe per OP-16 on each test window and aggregating. Separately, we will run a real-fills simulation (using cached OPRA with bid/ask and slippage model) on the three J anchor days to compare engine P&L vs. BS-sim baseline and compute delta edge_capture.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 guideline).  
2. **Sample bias:** The walk-forward window uses 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 (4 quarters) which may not capture regime shifts; overfit risk is mitigated by walk-forward design but remains if the engine has been tuned on the same period.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward test not yet executed).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real-fills simulation on top 3 J days not yet executed).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large adverse move on a loser day causing engine to take the trade and incur loss beyond the J loss cap; max drawdown scenario if engine takes multiple losing days in a row; blow-up scenario if engine increases position size on losing days due to faulty signal.  
6. **Concentration:** If the top-5 days contribute X% of P&L, we will disclose X after test completion; currently unknown.
